notes: The montage shows nuclei with broadly granular Pol2 signal but virtually no colored foci overlays are visible (only 1-2 faint outlines per nucleus at most), consistent with the very low median of 6 foci/cell — well below the expected ~10 discrete foci per nucleus in 3D. The detector threshold appears too stringent, causing most genuine Pol2 clusters to be missed; lowering the intensity threshold and minimum size cutoff should recover the sparse but real discrete foci without substantially over-detecting diffuse nucleoplasmic background.
